t: Forge Steel 250mm (9.8") scaffold level engineered for precise alignment across diverse trade construction projects. The compact and durable spirit level is indispensable for professionals installing scaffolding, laying brickwork, or fitting kitchen cabinets, to achieve accurate results. Designed with a robust aluminium box section frame, ensuring lightweight handling and resilience on busy building sites. Featuring 2 x vials for 90° horizontal and 180° vertical measurements, it provides a reliable 1mm accuracy. The strong magnetic base securely attaches to metal, enabling hands-free operation and consistent readings for efficient work.
